question: Which statement about Syama Sastri is correct?

options.text: His famous composition is Pancharatna Kritis.
A crater on planet mercury is named after him.
He is one among the trinity of Carnatic Music.

solution:
The correct answer is __**option 4**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Syama Sastri** is a revered name in the world of Carnatic music, a classical music tradition originating in South India.
 
• He is considered one of the "Trinity" of Carnatic music, along with Tyagaraja and Muthuswami Dikshitar.
 
• Syama Sastri introduced several musical innovations, including new ragas (musical scales) and rhythmic patterns.
 
• He was not only a skilled musician but also a talented poet and writer.
 
• His compositions often incorporated literary elements, such as metaphors and symbolism.
